answer: Milestone bond: each identity locks 70 credit and clears three milestones along the jetty, filing one whisper record of fresh work at each for auditors to replay against the river log. A missed milestone or reused record burns the bond. One fake costs 70 plus 45 per milestone, so 1,000 fakes cost 205,000 against 40,000 in rewards. A rented milestone fails because records carry the agent's own key. Honest agents pay 70 once, refunded next epoch.
